title: Mercury 3 - AI jo ek saath likhta hai
content:
Ye AI ek-ek word nahi likhta. Ye poora jawab EK SAATH banata hai.
And it is claiming over one thousand tokens per second.
Inception naam ki company ne launch kiya hai Mercury 3.
Ye ek diffusion LLM hai.
Normal ChatGPT jaise models left se right, ek token ke baad doosra token likhte hain.
Diffusion model starts with a rough draft of the whole answer and refines it in parallel.
Bilkul jaise image AI ek blurry photo ko step by step saaf karta hai.
Numbers dekho.
Company ke hisaab se, NVIDIA GPUs pe 1,068 tokens per second.
Context window ek MILLION tokens.
Aur ye Mercury 1 se forty times zyada bada model hai.
These are company-reported numbers, so test them on your own task.
Ab wo part jo aapke budget ke liye important hai.
Launch pe price hai point one zero dollar per million input tokens.
Aur point three five dollar per million output tokens.
Ye fifty percent off launch price hai. Normal price double hai.
Ab practical sawaal... iska use kaise karein?
Ye OpenAI API compatible hai.
That means if your app already calls an OpenAI-style API, you mostly change the base URL, the key and the model name.
Ye OpenRouter, Baseten aur Vercel pe bhi available hai.
Kahan use karein? Jahan speed sabse zyada matter karti hai.
Voice assistants, customer support chat, live search, aur agents jo bahut saare steps chalate hain.
Maan lo aapka agent ek task mein dus model calls karta hai... har call fast hui, toh poora task fast.
Mera take simple hai... speed tabhi kaam ki hai jab jawab sahi ho.
So run your own twenty test questions before you switch.
Sasta aur fast model, galat jawab de, toh koi fayda nahi.
Launch post ka link chahiye? Comment DIFFUSE and I'll DM you the link.
Follow karo, roz ka AI update yahin milega.
